subject: lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster

messages.author: e5c4db1a1cffab6b
messages.subject: lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster
parts:
Dear all,

I am getting the following error after running this model. Could you please anybody help me? The error is not very clear to me.

sem_2pm <- sem(model, data=data.pf, std.lv=F,
                cluster = "village", estimator="dwls",
               optim.method ="GN")
lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster

Thanks
Ale

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster
parts:
You must be requesting cluster-robust SEs for a single-level model.  That is only available with (robust) ML estimation, not DWLS.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
